I have been farming this land for 30 years, and I know every corner of my 6.5 mu. My father taught me wheat-maize double cropping, and that is what I still do. It is October now, time to plant wheat. I will put all 6.5 mu into winter wheat. First I will rotary till the field — that is how we always prepare for wheat. I will buy improved wheat seed from the shop in town. Last year I saved my own seed and the yield was only 800 jin per mu, not good. This year I will spend the money on good seed.

For fertilizer, I do not read numbers well, but I know how many bags to buy. I will put down about one bag of compound fertilizer per mu at planting, and then topdress with urea at jointing and again at heading if the wheat looks yellow. That is about 18 kg of nitrogen per mu in total. My neighbor Old Wang does the same and his wheat always looks green and strong. I will irrigate four times: once right after sowing, once in winter if the ground is dry, once at jointing in spring, and once when the grain is filling. The well water costs money to pump, but without irrigation the wheat will not make it here — we do not get enough rain. For pests, I will spray herbicide once in early spring and insecticide twice if I see aphids or other bugs. Three sprays total.

After we harvest the wheat in early June, there is no time to waste. I will plant summer maize right away — denghai605, the hybrid seed everyone uses. You cannot save maize seed anymore, it does not grow right. I will do no-tillage planting directly into the wheat stubble. There is simply no time to plow between the two crops. Maize does not need as much feeding as wheat. I will put some starter fertilizer down at planting and side-dress urea when the maize is knee-high — about 12 kg of nitrogen per mu total. I will irrigate twice: once after planting if it is dry, and once at the big ear stage. For pests on maize, the corn borer is trouble every year, so I will spray insecticide three times and herbicide once — four sprays total.

I expect about 450 kg per mu for wheat this year. Last year was 400 kg, but with bought seed and careful watering I should do better. For maize, I usually get around 500 kg per mu with the hybrid seed. My son works in a factory and sends some money home, so we can afford the inputs, but I will not buy the most expensive things. I will stick with what my neighbors do and what has worked before.
